traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: This report contains three sequential studies: (1) the Initial validation study (2 successive dilutions), whose per-category relative trueness results are given in Table 4 (page 5/15) and were used for this extraction as the primary/canonical study; (2) an Extension study using One Plate/one dilution interpretation, whose per-category results are given in Table 17 (very similar values, e.g. Meat products bias -0.07/SD 0.27/LCL -0.64/UCL 0.50 vs -0.08/0.26/-0.63/0.46 for Two Plates) - these were not recorded since they duplicate the same categories under a different protocol variant; (3) an Extension study using automatic reading by Petrifilm Plate Reader Advanced (PPRA), whose category-level table was not fully visible in the provided pages. The Acceptability Limit of ±0.5 log was confirmed from the interlaboratory accuracy profile study (Table 12) and the accuracy profile figures (Figure 9), consistent throughout the report. The 'All categories'/'All cat.' aggregate rows seen in Table 4 and Table 17 were excluded per instructions.
